Welcome to The North West Surrey Short Stay School. From Possibility to Actuality. Integrity...Respect...Resilience.
Welcome
Our vision for NWSSSS is to provide a safe, welcoming and nurturing environment for pupils who, for whatever reason, have not been successful in a mainstream setting. Through a trauma informed approach, we want to help pupils to realise their worth and be excited and ambitious for a future beyond our setting. We are experts in supporting pupils who have lived with adverse childhood experiences, and we want to share those practices with schools in our area.
We know that, with the support of our partner agencies and the dedicated staff team, we are in an excellent position to meet our goals and support the students with the challenges they face.
Progress in our setting is through supporting the development of the 'whole child' by ensuring that our pupils feel welcomed and valued and their individual needs are met so that they can access learning.

Work Experience
Work experience is coordinated by the Deputy Head Teacher.
Work experience is planned to meet the needs and interests of the individual student. It may vary in length from a few half day visits to a block of weeks or a regular weekly programme.
All work experience providers are thoroughly vetted, risk assessed and monitored regularly by NWSSSS.

pageCache.pageTitle: North West Surrey Short Stay School - Admissions
pageCache.text:
Admissions
Mainstream schools refer directly to the NWSSSS for preventative work and emergency planned places are agreed with schools, parents and the LA.
The Operational Guidance document is used to guide admissions.
School Referral Information
Referrals for the Early Intervention Programme are made via secure email to the Headteacher.
Referrals to other intervention programmes are discussed with the school, Headteacher, Local Authority, Behaviour and Attendance Partnerships and In Year Fair Access Panels (IYFAPs) in each borough.
When a child is permanently excluded from a mainstream school, the Local Authority contact us and we will contact you to arrange an interview with you and your child. We recognise that permanent exclusion is a traumatic event for your child and you as parents. We want to reassure that we will work with you and your child to ensure that their education continues and with a fresh start further opportunities beyond us will be sought and supported.
